A115.summary: An Ordnungspolizei radiogram of the Higher SS and Police Leader Russia Centre to Himmler and the Chief of the Order Police: in partisan fighting on the Bobruisk-Mogilev road 16 men of Police Battalion 51 fell; the village of Borki, where arms and ammunition were found, was razed and its inhabitants 'liquidated'. Borki (Kirovsk district, Mogilev region) was destroyed with six neighbouring settlements on 15 June 1942.
A115.en:
To the Reichsführer-SS and the Chief of the Order Police. On the Bobruisk-Mogilev road, partisan fighting: 16 men of
Police Battalion 51 fell. The village of Borki, in which arms and ammunition were found, was razed to the ground. The
inhabitants liquidated. From the Higher SS and Police Leader Russia Centre.

snip.cap: W/T Red Form from intercept station 51 for the Mogilev message of 16 June 1942, with the discriminator ARTTN and the first cipher groups
snip.credit: NARA, RG 457, HCC, Box 202, via Weierud (CryptoCellar, 2020)

system: Doppelkasten: double Playfair with two 5x5 boxes, plaintext in double lines of 17 (21 in the Army NI variant), each pair enciphered twice through the same boxes; daily key of 16 June 1942, discriminator ARTTN.
